errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No one asked: log in to the pages first.

base.description: The commit its target branch is at, in hex.

head.description: The commit its head branch is at, in hex.

state.description: clean when it can merge now; conflicting when its head does not merge with its base; blocked when its checks have not all passed, or it is not reviewed as its target branch's rule asks; draft, whatever else holds, while its author has not marked it ready.

checks.description: Where its checks stand at its head merged with its base: pending for those not run there; none when the repository names no runners, so a merge waits for none, or when it conflicts.

method.description: How it would merge: a merge commit naming the pull; into a branch protected as linear, one squashed commit. fastForward is no longer made.

reason.description: Why it cannot merge now, in the words a merge would refuse it with; and when the account asking may not merge it, that too.

deletes.description: Its head branch, which merging deletes unless asked to keep it.

reviews.description: Where its reviews stand against what its target branch's rule asks of them (dev.knotless.repo#reviews): none when the rule asks nothing of them, or when it conflicts.

queueOnly.description: Its target branch takes pulls only through the merge queue: queue it with dev.knotless.queuePull, as dev.knotless.mergePull refuses it. Absent is false.

queueBlocked.description: Why the merge queue would not land it yet, when this server knows: undelegated when no runner the repository names may push, so its queue lands through this server's gateway, and the owner has not delegated writes to it.

reviewsMissing.description: What its reviews lack, each as `knotless pull merge --check` lists it: `reviews 1 of 2`, `owners of web/: @alice or @bob`, `changes asked by @carol`.

reviewsUncounted.description: The approvals that do not count toward its target branch's rule, and why: `@dan's approval does not count: only the owner's and collaborators' approvals count`, or one of an earlier head when only approvals of its head as it is now count.

codeOwnersWarnings.description: The lines of the target branch's CODEOWNERS file that were skipped, and why: one naming a team, say.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

main.description: Whether an open pull can merge now, decided as `knotless pull merge` decides it, without merging: whether its head merges with its target branch as it is now, and, in a repository that names runners, whether each workflow that runs on it passed there. And what the account asking may do to it: merge it, queue it, retarget it or run its checks again. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets, or a service token from the caller's PDS, audience the appview's DID, for this method.

note.description: A line of text about the pull's reviews.

conflict.description: A file that both sides changed so that they do not merge.

state.description: set while it stands; pushed once someone who may not merge it pushed to its head since, and retargeted once it moved to another branch, either of which cancels it.

pushedBy.description: For pushed, the owner of the head repository pushed to.

autoMerge.description: Where the pull's merge when checks pass stands, if it was ever set and not cancelled by someone: a runner the repository names merges it once it would merge.

base.description: Change its target branch: those who may close it.

head.description: Change its head branch: its author.

force.description: Merge it past its checks: the owner alone.

merge.description: Merge it: the owner and collaborators.

queue.description: Put it in the merge queue or take it out: those who may merge it, in a repository whose runners land a queue, while the branch it lands on takes pulls through the queue or it is already queued.

rerun.description: Ask the runners to run its checks again: the owner, in a repository that names runners.

autoMerge.description: Set it to merge by itself once its checks pass, with dev.knotless.setAutoMerge: those who may merge it, in a repository that names runners, into a branch with no merge queue. Cancelling that, those and its author may. Absent is false.

permissions.description: What the account asking may do to the pull: what its part in the repository lets it do, not whether that would work now. state and reason say that: a merge refuses a blocked pull, the owner's merge too, unless the owner forces it.

description: Whether an open pull can merge now, and what the account asking may do to it.
